target_customer: EPC and AEC engineering firms and project owners producing plant, substation and building engineering packages
problem: Engineering packages (P&IDs, line lists, datasheets, one-line diagrams, calculations) are drafted by hand and kept consistent manually, which slows infrastructure delivery.
business_model: B2B enterprise software for engineering firms, managed cloud or sovereign deployment
product_category: AI agentic engineering software for capital infrastructure projects

founders.name: Marcus Lima
education: Oxford and Cambridge graduate (per YC page)
previous_startups: Heimdal (YC S21), direct air carbon capture; company says he raised $12M+ and built a plant
founders.background_notes: YC page says he and the CTO are best friends of 13 years.

founders.name: Rahul Thayil
previous_startups: Orion, AI threat intelligence and response automation (company says he raised $4M+)
founders.background_notes: YC page says 10+ years building real-time anomaly detection over physical data. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Marengo
competitors.what: Engineering firm for data center development using internal AI design tools, site diligence through FEED and permitting design
competitors.traction_then: not stated beyond company claims of half the time and cost

technical_complexity.rationale: Keeping linked engineering documents consistent across P&IDs, datasheets and calculations, with engineer approval workflow and SOC 2, is hard for a team of 8 and needs domain depth.

defensibility.rationale: Early product with no named customers on the site. Integration into engineering workflows could build switching costs, but frontier model access makes copying plausible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of 2026-11. ENR 2026 coverage shows large design firms growing on data center demand, so they have motive to build internally.

market_need_then: ENR 2026 Top 500 reporting says design firm revenue rose 7.4% to $158.7B driven partly by data center work, implying engineering capacity strain. The company cites one unnamed major US EPC measuring 9.7x output per engineer hour, a vendor claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses usetorus.com, not the bare .com; company legal name is Torus Intelligence Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, patriotic builder tone: 'Built for engineers who build America.'

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found. Search results are crowded by unrelated Torus companies (energy storage, robotics, games), which dilutes the name.

outcome_analysis: Torus joined YC Summer 2026 with a team of 8 and an established founder pair, one of whom previously ran a YC S21 company. No outcome exists yet as of November 2026. No shutdown, layoff or acquisition coverage was found. The main risks are name confusion with other Torus firms, incumbents building in house, and unproven customer claims.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists a $125k seed and VCBeast lists a Form D filed around 2026-08 with no announcement or amount confirmed. Neither recorded as a round.
